acceptance.given: A clean fresh checkout evaluates the frozen pinned inputs through the Toolchain replay and coverage path.

oracle.expected: The fresh-checkout coverage result is byte-for-byte and semantically identical to the pinned-input coverage result, with matching verdict and coverage fields.
forbidden: Any coverage or semantic-verdict difference between pinned-input and fresh-checkout evaluations.
A result inferred without executing the fresh-checkout replay.
oracle.observable: The replay evaluation output contains both pinned-input and fresh-checkout result records and an explicit equality check that passes.

acceptance.then: Fresh-checkout replay evidence proves reproducibility from pinned inputs.
acceptance.when: When pinned inputs are evaluated in a fresh checkout.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate or omit one pinned input and rerun the fresh-checkout comparison; the equality assertion must fail deterministically.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or exercise a fresh-checkout replay comparison that evaluates the frozen pinned inputs and explicitly compares its coverage result and semantic verdict with the pinned-input evaluation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay input and result schemas; rollback removes only the fresh-checkout comparison logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: pinned inputs evaluated -> fresh checkout replayed -> coverage and verdict equality asserted -> reproducibility accepted or rejected
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The executed comparison records equal pinned-input and fresh-checkout coverage results and semantic verdicts, or returns a deterministic failure.

acceptance.given: Validator evaluation is run with a candidate whose external trust status is independently assessable.

oracle.expected: An independent candidate-external trust verification is executed and its evidence is recorded for this obligation.
forbidden: Trust is inferred solely from another verification result or replay result.
oracle.observable: The evaluation output contains a distinct candidate-external trust check and a corresponding evidence record linked to the candidate identity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run evaluation with candidate-external trust verification disabled or replaced by a derived trust flag; the independent-trust assertion must produce the expected red result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure validator evaluation performs a distinct candidate-external trust check and emits independently attributable evidence rather than reusing another verification.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing replay and evidence formats; rollback removes only the independent trust-check path.

slice_hint.state_transition: candidate loaded -> external trust checked independently -> trust evidence recorded -> evaluation continues or rejects
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A distinct trust-check event and evidence record are present and are not derived from another verification.

acceptance.given: An adversarial dependency case is submitted to the Toolchain success evaluator.

oracle.expected: The evaluator returns a non-success result and identifies the adversarial dependency condition as the reason for rejection.
forbidden: Success is accepted for the adversarial dependency case.
The case is skipped, treated as inconclusive, or accepted from an unrelated cached result.
oracle.observable: The executed evaluator result has a non-success verdict with dependency-case evidence.

acceptance.then: The adversarial dependency case is rejected for success.
acceptance.when: An adversarial dependency case is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Present the adversarial dependency fixture to the success evaluator and assert that a success verdict is incorrectly accepted; the guard must fail on any green result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the success evaluation path classify the adversarial dependency case and reject success with an observable non-success verdict.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve normal success evaluation behavior; rollback removes only the adversarial dependency rejection branch.

slice_hint.state_transition: adversarial dependency case submitted -> dependency condition evaluated -> non-success verdict emitted
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The adversarial dependency case produces a non-success result with dependency evidence.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and includes a Probe subject that must be checked independently.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records an independently executed Probe verification linked to that result.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result without independent Probe verification.
Probe status copied or inferred solely from the overall replay verdict.
oracle.observable: The result contains a distinct Probe verification event and evidence reference whose execution is attributable separately from the success decision.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result independently verifies its Probe.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Suppress or replace the independent Probe execution while allowing the Replay Result to succeed; the success-result Probe assertion must produce the expected red result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every successful Replay Result to execute and record a distinct Probe verification rather than deriving Probe status from aggregate replay success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep Replay Result schema compatibility; rollback removes only the independent Probe verification requirement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay Result succeeds -> Probe executes independently -> Probe evidence linked -> successful result accepted or rejected
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every successful Replay Result contains an independently attributable Probe execution and evidence link.
